title: The app server's nightly clean-up run is never tested as a whole
what: Each delete step is tested alone, but no test runs the nightly job itself. Nothing checks that the 10-minute payment check skips the clean-up, that a missing database stops the job with a clear line instead of crashing, or that one missing table leaves the other steps running.
expected: A test runs the nightly job and the 10-minute job and checks which steps ran, the log line for each, and that one failing step does not stop the others.
who: everyone whose data the clean-up promises to delete
fix_line: Add one test that calls the scheduled job with each timer and with no database

title: No test shows what owners and staff see when alerts cannot be switched on
what: When the alerts key is not set up or the HQ server is down, the admin app should say alerts cannot be switched on now. No test drives this; every alerts test hands the browser a working key. The browser is also asked for permission before the key is checked, so a person can allow alerts and then be told they cannot have them.
expected: A test with the key address failing shows the plain 'not ready' line and no success.
how_often: whenever the HQ link is down
fix_line: Add an alerts test where the key address answers not set up

title: The WhatsApp delivery log lines HQ relies on are barely tested
what: HQ reads these log lines to find out why a sign-in code never arrived. Tests check the answer codes, but not the 'bad signature' and 'webhook check refused' lines, the title and details of a failure, that a failure is logged as an error, one line per status in order, or the 'Too large' refusal.
expected: Tests check each log line HQ reads, and that an over-size post is refused unread.
who: HQ, and owners waiting for a code
fix_line: Assert the log lines and add an over-size post test

title: The Help box's daily limit and length limit are never tested on the Help address
what: The daily message limit, the 'Keep it under 2000 letters.' wording and the daily free question lines for owners and staff are tested only on the plain feedback address, or not at all. Nothing proves a refused Help message never calls the AI.
expected: A Help test sends one message past the limit and checks the refusal words and that no AI call was made.
fix_line: Add Help address tests for the daily limit and the length limit

title: No test proves a crash report drops the gym code and install id
what: The crash test checks that the saved row has an empty gym and sender, but the report it sends never contains a gym code or install id. So the promise that these are never kept is not tested. It also never sends a member-app crash.
expected: A test sends a member crash with a gym code and an install id and checks neither is saved.
fix_line: Send a gym code and install id in the crash test and assert they are gone

title: A demo request from a member's shared link is never tested on the page
what: The landing page should mark a demo request as a member referral when opened from a member's shared link. Tests send that label to the server directly. No page test opens the link and checks the label reaches HQ.
expected: A landing page test opens the member link, sends a demo request and sees it saved as a member referral.
fix_line: Add a landing page test opened with the member link

title: The alerts key address has no time limit when HQ is slow, and no test of it
what: When the admin app asks for the alerts key, the server waits for the HQ server with no time limit. A slow HQ means the switch spins until the platform gives up. No test covers a slow HQ, and the 'GET_ONLY' answer words are not checked.
expected: The key request gives up after a few seconds with 'UNREACHABLE', and a test proves it.
who: owners and front desk turning on alerts
fix_line: Add a short time limit to the HQ key request and a test
